feedback: Format and most structure are correct: headers (REWARD_MACHINE/STATES/INITIAL_STATE/FINAL_STATES/TRANSITION_FUNCTION/REWARD_FUNCTION) match the paper format; FINAL_STATES is nonempty, its states are declared and accepting (u0 and u1 both mean 'no top breach yet', matching the environment's success flag); guards use only the four event propositions; per-state guards are mutually exclusive and exhaustive with else self-loops in u0, u1 and u2; combined events are handled (side_breach + plant_trampled -> -1.5) and top_breach correctly dominates into an absorbing failure state u2 with a bounded -1000; all states are reachable; the machine is compact; no regressions are needed and none are faked. The fatal flaw is the treatment of zombie_killed. (1) Kills are rewarded exactly once: the only positive reward is the u0->u1 milestone (+1). In u1 - the state the machine occupies for essentially the whole of a successful episode - zombie_killed has no transition line and no reward and falls into the (u1, else) self-loop, i.e., the machine treats the task's central positive event as if it were irrelevant. Else self-loops are reserved for irrelevant events; zombie_killed is not irrelevant: killing is the only way to stop a zombie (they cannot be blocked, and every uncaught zombie breaches within 27 steps), so it underwrites both the hard top-lane constraint and the soft side-lane goal. (2) Positive progress is one-shot, not dense-but-bounded: the task is ongoing maintenance over roughly 18-37 zombies per episode (the example trace shows 21 kills), and 'try to stop the zombies of the other lanes too' asks for repeated stopping, but the entire positive signal is a single +1; after the first kill, stopping a side zombie is represented only as the discounted avoidance of a future -1 up to 27 steps away, a far weaker and sparser signal than a bounded per-kill reward. (3) The u0/u1 split encodes a 'first clean kill' milestone the task never defines (the task's structure is safe vs. top-breach-failed, not has-killed-once vs. not), and because the milestone guard demands a fully clean step (!top_breach & !side_breach & !plant_trampled & zombie_killed), a first kill that coincides with a side breach pays -1, earns no +1, and stays in u0 - the milestone silently slips. Required fix direction (described, not rewritten): keep the safe/failed structure and current priorities (top_breach -> absorbing failure at -1000; side_breach -1; plant_trampled -0.5; combined -1.5), but give every zombie_killed a bounded positive reward via an explicit self-loop in the safe state(s), and either drop the u0/u1 distinction or ground it in the task. FINAL_STATES should remain the top-breach-free states.
